title: DriftWorkflowCompileAck
description: Contract C2 response: one acknowledgement per drift workflow that the reconciler rendered (buildAcks(request).drift of src/reconcile.mjs). SPEC-02 validates each entry here, as the consumer of the workflow it will run.

workflowId.description: The identifier of the workflow, drift-<projectKey>; it is the one used in the title of the failure issue.

targetRepo.description: The repository the workflow maintains: its safe-outputs.create-pull-request.target-repo.

allowedNetworkDomains.description: Literal hostnames of the watched URLs: the network.allowed of the workflow. A wildcard is never allowed.

gateCommands.description: The verifyCommands that post-steps run, in order.
